# FMEApex — AI-Powered FMEA Quality Risk Platform

FMEApex is a cloud-native, multi-tenant quality engineering platform built for Automotive (IATF 16949), Aerospace (AS9100), Medical Devices (ISO 13485 / ISO 14971), and High-Tech Manufacturing. It automates the AIAG-VDA 2019 7-Step FMEA methodology, enforces bidirectional Process Flow Diagram (PFD) to PFMEA linking, synchronizes Control Plans in real time, and guarantees 21 CFR Part 11 compliant audit trails.

## Core Platform Capabilities

- **AIAG-VDA 7-Step Quality Workflow**: Guided step-by-step analysis with strict prerequisite step gating (Planning, Structure Analysis, Function Analysis, Failure Analysis, Risk Analysis, Optimization, Documentation).
- **Automated Action Priority (AP) Calculation**: Instant lookup of High, Medium, or Low Action Priority derived strictly from AIAG-VDA 2019 Severity, Occurrence, and Detection (S/O/D 1-10) scoring tables.
- **Bidirectional PFD ↔ PFMEA Sync**: Ensures every step in the Process Flow Diagram maps directly to a PFMEA row, automatically flagging orphan steps and coverage gaps.
- **Control Plan Synchronization**: Real-time propagation of prevention and detection controls between PFMEA and Control Plans in a single serializable transaction.
- **Corrective Action Lifecycles**: Complete action tracking with Cloudflare R2 evidence file storage and automated before/after risk evaluation recalculation.
- **21 CFR Part 11 Audit Trail & Signatures**: Role-segregated approval workflows (Creator vs Reviewer vs Approver), immutable locked revisions, and cryptographic audit logging.
